item.title: Class of 2026 Celebrates 100 Days Dance
item.description: From 10 p.m. to 1 a.m. on Feb. 6, the class of 2026 celebrated the 100 Days Dance, a yearly formal dedicated to celebrating seniors' last 100 days together before they graduate in May."It is 100 days until graduation, so it marks a really significant, exciting, sad, emotional night for the entire class," said Vivie Koo, co-chair of the senior class council's 100 Days Dance Committee.Koo began planning the dance in the fall alongside a committee of about ten other seniors. item.title: Notre Dame receives "F" grade from Students for Life of America
item.description: In their Mid-Year Report Card for Christian Schools, Students for Life of America dropped Notre Dame's grade from a "B" to an "F"grade. The update was announced Feb. 12. According toa SFLA news releasefollowing the decision, the downgradecame as a direct result ofprofessor Susan Ostermann's appointment as director of the Keough School of Global Affairs' Liu Institute of Asia and Asian Studies. item.description: The Noble Family Dining Hall at Saint Mary's College serves breakfast, lunch and dinner to much of the campus community. item.title: Theology book club returns with one-credit Graham Greene course
item.description: For the third year in a row, the Theology department has hosted a one-credit 'book club' course. This year's class is focused on the 20th century english author, Graham Greene.Graham Greene, known for theological themes in his books, was born in 1904 and attended the University of Oxford before becoming an author for 67 years until his death in 1991. item.title: Realignment shakes college football once again in 2026
item.description: In the modern era of college football, realignment has shattered the once-illustrious scene of regional conference rivalries. Simultaneously, the number of FBS independents has gradually dwindled, leaving only Notre Dame and UConn. In 2023, independents BYU, Liberty and New Mexico State joined conferences: the Cougars headed to the Big 12 while the Flames and Aggies joined Conference USA. item.title: South Dining Hall renovations bring minor frustrations
item.description: Amid ongoing renovations at South Dining Hall, some students report persistent inconveniences, from damp plates to a lack of silverware.
